description: Domain radar: newly registered names from our discovery queue (NRD, registries, GitHub orgs). This is NOT a company profile. Returns apex, registration date, registrar, mailbox signal, quality score, and status (queued / quality_failed). startup_slug is set only after we promote a real homepage into the directory. Use search_startups for companies. Pro Lite and higher. 1 db credit. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

created_after.description: ISO date. Rows we first ingested on or after this time.

has_real_email.description: Mailbox on the domain (MX is not empty).

promoted.description: 'true' = only names that already have a public startup profile.

q.description: Substring match on apex or candidate name.

source.description: Raw source or bucket id, e.g. 'dot_ai_nrd' or 'dot_ai_zone'.

status.description: queued, quality_failed, promoted, rejected. Default is queued,quality_failed.

tld.description: Comma-separated TLDs, e.g. 'ai,io'. Maps to the NRD/CT sources.

name: search_domains
title: Search new domains
